voir_dire_record: I would require proof beyond any doubt before I could find for either side. I could not use a preponderance standard even if the judge told me to.
challenge_grounds: Juror refuses to apply the civil burden of proof.
context_notes: Clean grant: refusal to follow burden instruction.

case_theme: Juror has already decided that corporations lie.
voir_dire_record: I already believe companies like the defendant lie about contracts, and I do not think I could put that aside.
challenge_grounds: Juror admits fixed bias against defendant.

case_theme: Juror is skeptical of corporations but can follow the law.
voir_dire_record: I am sometimes skeptical of large companies, but I can listen to the evidence, follow the court's instructions, and decide from the record.
challenge_grounds: Defendant argues skepticism toward large companies shows bias.
context_notes: Clean denial: lawful attitude with credible assurance.

case_theme: Juror sets a damages floor before hearing evidence.
voir_dire_record: If plaintiff proves any breach, I would award at least $100,000 because small awards do not teach anyone a lesson.
challenge_grounds: Juror has a fixed damages floor unrelated to evidence.

case_theme: Juror can evaluate digital records with authentication.
voir_dire_record: I prefer paper records, but if the judge admits electronic records and explains the standard, I can evaluate them like other evidence.
challenge_grounds: Plaintiff argues skepticism of electronic records requires excusal.
context_notes: Clean denial: preference does not prevent service.

case_theme: Juror refuses to credit digital evidence.
voir_dire_record: I would not rely on electronic records in any civil case. Digital files can always be faked, and I would disregard them even if admitted.
challenge_grounds: Juror cannot fairly evaluate admitted digital evidence.
context_notes: Contextual grant: refusal to evaluate a class of admitted evidence.

case_theme: Juror has a financial interest in defendant.
voir_dire_record: My retirement account includes a direct stock position in defendant, and I would be upset if a verdict lowered its value.
challenge_grounds: Juror has a financial interest in defendant and admits concern about verdict effect.

case_theme: Juror has a remote vendor relationship but can be fair.
voir_dire_record: My employer once bought software from defendant, but I was not involved, have no financial stake, and can decide this case only on the evidence.
challenge_grounds: Plaintiff argues any prior vendor relationship requires excusal.
context_notes: Contextual denial: remote relationship with assurance.

case_theme: Juror cannot rule against a small business.
voir_dire_record: I run a small business and would have a hard time finding against another small business owner, even if the instructions pointed that way.
challenge_grounds: Juror cannot be impartial against a small-business plaintiff.
context_notes: Contextual grant: sympathy bias affects verdict.

case_theme: Juror initially expressed concern but was rehabilitated.
voir_dire_record: At first I said contract cases seem technical, but after the judge explained the task I can follow the instructions, ask for clarification through the court if needed, and decide from the evidence.
challenge_grounds: Plaintiff argues the initial concern shows inability to serve.
context_notes: Contextual denial: later answer gives credible assurance.

case_theme: Juror cannot understand the proceedings well enough to serve.
voir_dire_record: I cannot follow spoken English well enough to understand witness answers, and I do not think I could track the judge's instructions during trial.
challenge_grounds: Juror cannot understand testimony or instructions well enough to serve.
context_notes: Adversarial grant: inability to understand proceedings.

case_theme: Juror has scheduling hardship but can attend and deliberate.
voir_dire_record: Serving would be inconvenient because I manage childcare, but I arranged coverage for the trial dates and can pay attention during trial.
challenge_grounds: Defendant argues hardship will distract the juror.
context_notes: Adversarial denial: inconvenience without inability to serve.

case_theme: Juror knows the case and refuses to set aside an opinion.
voir_dire_record: I read about this dispute before trial and formed the opinion that defendant cheated plaintiff. I do not think evidence in court would change my mind.
challenge_grounds: Juror has a fixed case-specific opinion.

case_theme: Juror dislikes lawsuits but promises to apply the law.
voir_dire_record: I think too many lawsuits get filed, but I understand this case is here for decision. I can follow the court's instructions and decide whether this plaintiff proved the claim.
challenge_grounds: Plaintiff argues general lawsuit skepticism requires excusal.
context_notes: Adversarial denial: general attitude with assurance.

case_theme: Juror sets a damages cap before hearing evidence.
voir_dire_record: No matter what the documents show, I could never award more than $10,000 in a contract case because bigger awards are excessive.
challenge_grounds: Juror has a fixed damages cap unrelated to evidence.

case_theme: Juror gives an unequivocal final assurance after awkward first answer.
voir_dire_record: I first said I tend to trust written contracts more than testimony. When asked again, I said I can weigh both documents and testimony under the judge's instructions and I have not decided who should win.
challenge_grounds: Defendant argues the first answer shows document bias.
context_notes: Adversarial denial: rehabilitation after ambiguous first answer.
